popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Diomedes warns Glaucus that even Dryas' son Lycurgus did not live long after he hunted Dionysus — the Thracian father named as pedigree of a doomed persecutor.

popCulture.title: Dryas (mythology)
popCulture.description: Father of Lycurgus of Thrace — distinct from Dryas son of Lycurgus and other Dryades of myth.
